mendeley_dataset_snapshot.name: Embryoid Body data for PHATE
mendeley_dataset_snapshot.description: Single cell RNA sequencing for embryoid body data generated over 27 day time course. Bulk RNA-sequencing data was generated from FACS sorted embryoid bodies using the indicated surface marker. Used to demonstrate the data visualization method PHATE.
